name: Radarr and Sonarr Refresh Chatter
description: Drops the routine library refresh lines of Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr and Readarr: updating info, scanning disk, and finding no existing metadata, subtitle or extra files. Matched on the message, so it works whatever the containers are called.
message_pattern: \bRefresh(?:Movie|Series|Artist|Author|Book)Service: Updating |\bDiskScanService: (?:Completed scanning disk for|Scanning) |\bFound 0 existing (?:metadata|subtitle|other extra) files\b|\bFound 0 possible extra files, imported 0 files\b
